title: The Name sort covers every category, not only those on screen
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Admin at {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919), with the Settings - Parts permission.
  • The organization of {Location-A} has more than 1,000 categories in all (for example 1,100), as the largest shop has 1,076.
  • Category {Category-A} (for example 0000-ZZAUTOTEST-PCA11 first) exists. Its name comes before every other category's name.
  • Category {Category-B} (for example zzzz-ZZAUTOTEST-PCA11 last) exists. Its name comes after every other category's name.
  • {Category-B} was not among the first 30 categories in today's list (it sorts at the far end).
  • You are on a page other than Categories.
custom_steps:
1. Go to Settings and click Categories in the Parts group of the Settings menu.
  2. Wait until the list has finished loading.
  3. Read the second row.
  4. Scroll to the end of the list.
  5. Read the last row.
  6. Scroll back to the top of the list.
  7. Click the Name column header.
  8. Read the second row.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 3: the second row is {Category-A}, directly under the Default category.
  • Steps 4 and 5: the last row is {Category-B}. No loading indicator appeared while scrolling and no rows were added out of order.
  • Step 8: straight after the click, without any scrolling, the second row is {Category-B}, directly under the Default category. The sort reached a category that was far down the list.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-11258; story SV-10134 (Story 1, Categories, sort by name; story text re-synced to the PRD on 13 Oct 2026); PRD "Settings Pricing And Categories Sorting (Price/Category)", Confluence 578781186, version 21 (14 Oct 2026), S1-R8, §6 Assumptions, read 14 Oct 2026; design canvas board 1.2 (Categories - after), 13 Oct copy, unchanged on 14 Oct.
